title: Episode About Udasi to the East

blocks.text: The narrative then turns toward the western udasi, where Mardana confides to Baba Nanak that he has long desired to see Mecca and the Kaaba for himself. (1)

Guru Nanak rebukes him only for waiting so long to speak. At the Guru’s instruction Mardana closes his eyes, and when he opens them they have already reached the Kaaba and its surrounding places of pilgrimage. (2–3)

There the locked rear gate opens by itself, shrine keepers recognize that an extraordinary holy presence has arrived, and the search begins for the one whose coming has made sealed doors yield on their own. (4–7)
